claims: Fútbol is the Spanish term for association football (soccer).
Association football (soccer) is a sport played between two teams of 11 players.
In association football (soccer), players kick a round ball to score goals.
A standard match lasts 90 minutes.
Fútbol is distinct from fútbol americano (American football).
The term fútbol is derived from the English word "football".
The term fútbol is used in most Spanish-speaking countries.
Fútbol uses a round ball.
Fútbol lasts 90 minutes.
Fútbol americano uses a prolate spheroid (pointy oval).
Fútbol americano is played in four 15-minute quarters.
Fútbol americano has frequent clock stops.
Association football is called "soccer" in the US in English.
Association football is called "soccer" in Canada in English.
Association football is called "soccer" in parts of Australia in English.
Association football is called "football" in the UK in English.
Association football is called "football" in many other regions in English.
The word fútbol refers to the sport itself.
Fútbol Más uses the sport as a tool for social development, community mobilization, and teaching life skills to youth.
Love.fútbol uses the sport as a tool for social development, community mobilization, and teaching life skills to youth.
Fútbol Americas covers major leagues and players across CONCACAF.
